name: waffle-cockpit
description: Waffle-Commons cockpit: status lines under the prompt (model, effort, context, cache, cost, limits, repo, PR, Waffle phase, local-only commits and backup age, running commands, background shells / monitors / subagents), /dod in a pane with no model turn and the last verdict per component, /audit to decide a release audit's findings in a pane (and the audit's progress on the status line), model-callable dod / xref / coverage_gaps / dod_history tools, a Bash guard (host-side PHP, cd, heredoc continuations, secret files, submodule --remote syncs, release-tag pushes but the releaseTag option's, v-prefixed or moved tags, squash merges, forced pushes, ref deletes not spelled --delete), Edit/Write checks (new mixed, secrets, an audit ledger's decisions), the maintainer-only wfl audit:sign, an instant Mago check after each PHP edit, and a done-means-evidence reminder at the end of a turn.

contextWarn.title: Context: yellow from (%)
contextWarn.description: The context bar turns yellow from this percent.

contextAlert.title: Context: red from (%)
contextAlert.description: The context bar turns red from this percent.

jobLingerSeconds.title: Ended jobs stay (s)
jobLingerSeconds.description: How long an ended background job stays on its line, ticked or crossed.

instantLint.title: Instant Mago check
instantLint.description: Mago on each PHP file Claude edits, its findings handed to Claude: off, lint (fast), or lint+analyze (about 3 s).

evidenceAtStop.title: Done means evidence
evidenceAtStop.description: Before a turn ends, remind Claude once of components edited since their last green wfl dod.

guard.title: Guard strictness
guard.description: strict: also refuses cd on the host, a backslash after a heredoc start and new mixed in PHP. standard: host PHP, submodule --remote, release tags and secrets only.

secretScan.title: Secret scan
secretScan.description: Refuse an Edit or Write that adds a secret, and Read or shell reads of secret files (.env, keys).

backupWarnHours.title: Backup warning (h)
backupWarnHours.description: With local-only commits, the backup segment turns yellow past this many hours (red past three times).

releaseTag.title: Release tag Claude may push
releaseTag.description: The one release tag (0.1.0-beta7, no v) Claude may push and release by name when asked; it fires the LIVE wave. Empty: every release-tag push is refused. Clear it once the wave has shipped.
